from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import Output, SecretStrInput
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
import traceback
import os
import time

os.environ['NO_PROXY'] = '127.0.0.1,localhost,::1'

class AutonomousJobApplicationAgent(Component):
    display_name = "Autonomous Job Application Agent"
    description = "Executive AI TPM Multi-Search Hunter (Pan-India)."
    icon = "bot"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="openai_api_key", display_name="OpenAI API Key", required=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Execution Result", name="result", method="run_agent"),
    ]

    async def run_agent(self) -> str:
        try:
            start_time = time.time()
            MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 270 

            cv_ai_tpm = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_AI_TPM.pdf"
            cv_exec = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_Executive_Management.pdf"
            cv_core = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_Core_TPM.pdf"

            os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"] = self.openai_api_key
            persistent_dir = r"D:\ai_job_agent\chrome_profile"
            os.makedirs(persistent_dir, exist_ok=True)
            
            applied_jobs = []
            TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT = 10 
            processed_count = 0

            # UPDATED: Broader executive queries. The bot will try them one by one.
            search_queries = [
                "Director%20Program%20Manager%20AI",
                "Head%20of%20AI",
                "Principal%20Program%20Manager",
                "VP%20Artificial%20Intelligence",
                "Senior%20Technical%20Program%20Manager"
            ]

            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser_context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                    user_data_dir=persistent_dir,
                    headless=False,
                    args=["--start-maximized"],
                    viewport=None
                )
                
                page = browser_context.pages[0] if browser_context.pages else await browser_context.new_page()
                
                for query in search_queries:
                    # Stop if we hit 10 apps or run out of time
                    if processed_count >= TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT or time.time() - start_time > MAX_EXECUTION_TIME:
                        break

                    print(f"\n--- Hunting for: {query.replace('%20', ' ')} ---")
                    await page.goto(f"https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords={query}&location=India")
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

                    if "authwall" in page.url or await page.locator("input#session_key").first.is_visible():
                        print("--> Authwall detected. Waiting 45 seconds for manual bypass if needed...")
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(45000)
                        await page.goto(f"https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords={query}&location=India")
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

                    try:
                        filter_btn = page.locator("button:has-text('Easy Apply')").first
                        if await filter_btn.is_visible():
                            await filter_btn.click()
                            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                    for _ in range(4):
                        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 1500)
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

                    job_cards = page.locator(".job-card-container__link, .base-card__full-link, div.job-card-container").locator("visible=true")
                    total_cards = await job_cards.count()
                    
                    card_index = 0
                    
                    while processed_count < TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT and card_index < total_cards:
                        if time.time() - start_time > MAX_EXECUTION_TIME:
                            break

                        try:
                            card = job_cards.nth(card_index)
                            card_index += 1
                            
                            await card.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                            await card.click()
                            await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

                            title_el = page.locator(".job-details-jobs-unified-top-card__job-title h1, h2.t-24").first
                            job_title = await title_el.inner_text() if await title_el.count() > 0 else "Target Role"
                            job_title_clean = job_title.strip()

                            exclusion_list = ["engineering manager", "software manager", "assistant", "supervisor", "junior", "associate", "intern", "analyst"]
                            if any(exclude in job_title_clean.lower() for exclude in exclusion_list):
                                continue

                            jd_el = page.locator("#job-details, .jobs-description__container").first
                            jd_text = await jd_el.inner_text() if await jd_el.count() > 0 else ""
                            jd_lower = jd_text.lower()

                            if any(kw in jd_lower for kw in ["ai", "artificial intelligence", "generative ai", "llm", "machine learning"]):
                                selected_cv = cv_ai_tpm
                                cv_type = "AI TPM CV"
                            elif any(kw in jd_lower for kw in ["vp", "director", "p&l", "c-level", "head of"]):
                                selected_cv = cv_exec
                                cv_type = "Executive Management CV"
                            else:
                                selected_cv = cv_core
                                cv_type = "Core TPM CV"

                            easy_btn = page.locator("button.jobs-apply-button:has-text('Easy Apply')").first
                            if await easy_btn.is_visible():
                                await easy_btn.click()
                                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

                                phone_input = page.locator("input[id*='phone'], input[name*='phone']").first
                                if await phone_input.is_visible():
                                    await phone_input.fill("+918390801207")

                                file_input = page.locator("input[type='file']")
                                if await file_input.count() > 0 and os.path.exists(selected_cv):
                                    await file_input.first.set_input_files(selected_cv)
                                    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

                                submitted = False
                                for _ in range(6):
                                    next_btn = page.locator("button:has-text('Submit application'), button:has-text('Review'), button:has-text('Next'), button:has-text('Submit')").first
                                    if await next_btn.is_visible():
                                        b_text = await next_btn.inner_text()
                                        await next_btn.click()
                                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                                        if "submit" in b_text.lower():
                                            submitted = True
                                            break
                                    else:
                                        break

                                if submitted:
                                    applied_jobs.append(f"{job_title_clean} (Used {cv_type})")
                                    processed_count += 1
                                    print(f"Success! Applied to: {job_title_clean}")
                            
                            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                        except Exception:
                            continue

                await browser_context.close()

            if applied_jobs:
                summary_str = "\n".join([f"{idx+1}. {j}" for idx, j in enumerate(applied_jobs)])
                return f"Multi-Search Hunter successful! Applied to {len(applied_jobs)} roles:\n\n{summary_str}"
            
            return "Execution finished. Scanned multiple executive listings across India but found no new, unapplied Easy Apply positions."

        except Exception as e:
            return f"CRITICAL ERROR:\n{traceback.format_exc()}"
